# Mapping and Adoption Attestation

For each accepted inventory candidate, record the stable resource identifier, intended Terraform address, mapping
rationale, parent or dependent relationships, exact provider and module locks, and target boundary. Treat an address
as proposed until an authorized capability returns target-matched evidence.

An adoption attestation accounts for every approved candidate and no unapproved target. It records the authorized
outcome, reconciliation evidence, observation time, remaining differences, and any accepted exception. Classify
unresolved drift rather than treating it as a successful adoption.

Missing inventory scope, mapping evidence, stateful-operation evidence, or validation evidence is a blocker. This
reference does not authorize discovery, configuration generation, state changes, import, preview, or apply.
